question: What was the sequence of interventions and treatments for the left pelvic fluid collection, and what was the final outcome by discharge?

Chronology of interventions for the left pelvic collection

6. Because of the patient’s fever and leukocytosis she was initially on vancomycin/ceftazidime/metronidazole, then narrowed to piperacillin–tazobactam, and on discharge transitioned per ID to IV ertapenem for ~4 weeks.  

Final outcome by discharge  
• The newly placed drain site had completely collapsed and was removed.  
• The repositioned original drain remained in place with minimal serosanguinous output.  
• The patient was clinically improved, afebrile, with resolving leukocytosis, and discharged on a four-week course of ertapenem with plans for outpatient follow-up imaging.
